Theme

Latin word

foedus

foedus, foederis n.

noun, third declension

a treaty, a league; foul, horrible (of weather, sights, smells); a treaty, a league, a compact; foul, disgusting, ugly

In this lexicon

  • league

    also used · classical · Cic. Leg. 2.21 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 185

  • terrible

    also used · classical · Liv. 29.18.5 (Lewis & Short): foedissima tempestās

  • treaty

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Leg. 2.21 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 185, 188

  • yucky

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 29.61: cīmicēs foedissimum animal (Lewis & Short)
